title: Spain tours and the 1971 Town Hall guitar concert
summary: He recalls concerts in Spain and the Town Hall guitar concert, where he was the only black guitarist and recorded in one day.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So, in your career in the early 1970's what are among the most memorable thing? Any concerts in particular?
We did a lot of concerts and a lot of travelin', all in Spain...
How about the Town Hall concert in 1971, that resulted in a record.

Oh, the album, yeah that was really tough on me. Yep. Well, all those heavy guys, you know, and they included me-- I'm the only black guy in there. George Benson was on there but I... his company wouldn't let him release somethin'-- anyhow he didn't get any PR at all. But he was on the program, he played last. And I was on there, and it was heavy. All those guitar players, boy. But they made an album for me. The other guys was two and three-- myself and someone else they made a whole side.
